# Security Protocol Review

This document outlines the urgent need to investigate and optimize encryption standards for strategy 2026. This includes reviewing current encryption standards based on audit findings and assessing potential updates.

Additionally, an urgent investigation into API latency is required to ensure optimal performance and security.
